(rule! (let ((dummy 0)) (define (first-pos grid color) (first (find-color grid color))) (let* ((pivot (first-pos g 5)) (pr (first pivot)) (pc (second pivot))) (for*/fold ((out g)) ((r (in-range (rows g))) (c (in-range (cols g)))) (let ((v (at g r c)) (rr (- (* 2 pr) r)) (cc (- (* 2 pc) c))) (if (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 5)) (in-bounds? rr cc (rows g) (cols g))) (set-cell out rr cc v) out))))))

(rule!
  (let* ([pivot (first (find-color g 5))]
         [pr (first pivot)] [pc (second pivot)]
         [sources
          (for*/list ([r (in-range (rows g))] [c (in-range (cols g))]
                      #:when (and (not (= (at g r c) 0))
                                  (not (= (at g r c) 5))))
            (list r c (at g r c)))]
         [distance (lambda (cell)
                     (+ (abs (- (first cell) pr))
                        (abs (- (second cell) pc))))]
         [selected
          (for/fold ([best (first sources)]) ([cell (in-list (rest sources))])
            (if (< (distance cell) (distance best)) cell best))]
         [color (third selected)])
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([cell (in-list sources)])
      (if (= (third cell) color)
          (set-cell out (- (* 2 pr) (first cell))
                        (- (* 2 pc) (second cell)) color)
          out))))
